'''October''' is the ninth month in the [[Wikipedia:Gregorian calendar|Gregorian calendar]]. It occurs in Wheel of Time world during [[Shaldine]] [[Shaldine 3|3]] to [[Nesan]] [[Nesan 5|5]].
